## Other reconstruction methods

- [**Free-BBN: recreating the PlayStation Broadband Navigator dashboard**](https://github.com/jegesmedve09/Free-BBN) - Free-BBN recreates the PlayStation Broadband Navigator dashboard as a PS2 homebrew application built with ps2sdk and gsKit. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/free-bbn-case/)</sub>
- [**FSR 4 INT8: reconstructed GPU passes and comparison harness**](https://github.com/int3rrobang/fsr4-int8-reverse-engineering) - An FSR 4.1.1 INT8 investigation reconstructs the upscaler’s GPU passes in HLSL and compares their outputs with AMD’s compiled kernels through a D3D12 harness. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/fsr4-int8-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**Konami's Game Master: a matching MSX utility-cartridge disassembly**](https://github.com/ricbit/game-master) - Konami's Game Master reconstructs the Japanese RC-735 MSX utility cartridge as annotated assembly. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/konamis-game-master-disassembly-case/)</sub>
- [**L1J-Encode-CLI: reconstructed Lineage 1 ServerData codec**](https://github.com/Lan-0v0/L1J-Encode-CLI) - L1J-Encode-CLI reconstructs the Lineage 1 launcher's ServerData encoding as a Python encoder and decoder for IP addresses, ports, and feature flags. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/l1j-encode-cli-case/)</sub>
- [**NW Eft: decompiling the Wii U NintendoWare Eft library**](https://github.com/open-ead/NW4F-Eft) - NW Eft decompiles the NintendoWare for Cafe Eft library found in the Wii U game New Super Mario Bros. U. Its C++ source and headers cover emitters, rendering and related library components. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/nw4f-eft-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**open\_rvl: decompiling the Wii SDK used in Wii Sports**](https://github.com/kiwi515/open_rvl) - open\_rvl reconstructs the Wii SDK version found in Wii Sports as C source for reuse in game decompilations. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/open-rvl-sdk-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenSpy Core: reconstructing GameSpy online services**](https://github.com/openspy/openspy-core) - OpenSpy Core reconstructs GameSpy online services as separate processes communicating through HTTP, AMQP, and Redis. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openspy-core-case/)</sub>
- [**osdbits: reconstructing the PlayStation 2 OSDSYS opening**](https://github.com/aap/osdbits) - osdbits reconstructs the PlayStation 2 OSDSYS opening animation as a standalone Emotion Engine program from a retail boot ROM image. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/osdbits-case/)</sub>
- [**PictoChat: a matching DSi system-title decompilation**](https://github.com/tangOS-decomps/pictochat-decomp) - PictoChat's standalone DSi system title is being reconstructed as matching C source for its ARM components. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/pictochat-dsi-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**re\_nfpii: reimplementing the Wii U amiibo library**](https://github.com/GaryOderNichts/re_nfpii) - re\_nfpii reimplements the Wii U nn\_nfp.rpl library for amiibo emulation and research. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/re-nfpii-wii-u-library-case/)</sub>
- [**RFL: decompiling the Wii Mii library**](https://github.com/koopthekoopa/RFL) - RFL reconstructs the Wii library responsible for handling Miis from an original game image. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rfl-wii-mii-library-case/)</sub>
- [**Strato: Nintendo Switch system emulation on Android**](https://github.com/strato-emu/strato) - Strato reconstructs Nintendo Switch system behavior in an emulator for ARMv8 Android devices. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/strato-switch-emulation-case/)</sub>
- [**UniSpy Server: rebuilding GameSpy services in Python**](https://github.com/GameProgressive/UniSpyServer) - UniSpy Server rebuilds GameSpy online services in Python using published GameSpy protocol research and an earlier server library as references. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/unispy-server-case/)</sub>
- [**zwift-api: mapping Zwift's private data endpoints**](https://github.com/noerdk/zwift-api) - zwift-api maps selected private Zwift HTTP data interfaces and implements a read-only Node client for profile, achievements, events, quests and catalogue data. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/zwift-api-case/)</sub>
